fields.title: Heart defects
fields.bodyHtml:
Heart defects: advanced treatment in Israel

Advanced diagnosis of heart defects:

  1. Clinical examination and history: It is important to establish the type and severity of the symptoms and whether there are any accompanying conditions.
  2. Echocardiography: An ultrasound examination that allows the structure of the heart to be imaged and the function of the valves assessed.
  3. Electrocardiogram (ECG): A recording of the electrical activity of the heart, which may indicate abnormalities associated with heart defects.
  4. Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) of the heart: Gives a detailed picture of the structure of the heart and helps establish the anatomical features of the defect.
  5. Cardiac catheterisation and angiography: Allow assessment of the pressure in the chambers of the heart and the state of the coronary vessels.
  6. Laboratory tests:
    • Blood tests: full blood count, biochemistry, markers of inflammation.
    • Specific tests to identify infectious agents where infective endocarditis is suspected.

Treatments for heart defects:

  1. Drug treatment:
    • Aimed at controlling symptoms, improving the working of the heart and preventing complications.
  2. Surgery:
    • Valve repair or valve replacement with artificial or biological prostheses.
    • Correction of defects of the ventricular and atrial septum.
  3. Interventional cardiology:
    • Minimally invasive methods, including balloon valvuloplasty and closure of defects of the ventricular and atrial septum through a catheter.
  4. Rehabilitation:
    • A comprehensive recovery programme after surgery or intensive care, aimed at improving quality of life and returning the patient to normal activity.

Advantages of treatment in Israel:

  • A multidisciplinary approach: Cardiologists, cardiac surgeons, rehabilitation specialists and others combine their efforts to create the most effective treatment plan.
  • An individual treatment plan: Every feature of the patient's condition is taken into account in order to achieve the best results.
  • Access to the newest technology: The use of the latest medical advances in diagnosing and treating heart defects.
  • A high quality of medical care: A distinguishing feature of Israeli medicine, offering strong prospects of successful treatment and recovery.

Treatment of heart defects in Israel aims at an active improvement in the patient's condition and their return to a full life, minimising risks and possible complications.

fields.title: Prostatitis
fields.bodyHtml:
Prostatitis: modern treatment in Israel

Prostatitis is inflammation of the prostate gland, which can cause various symptoms including pain, problems passing urine and sexual difficulties. Israel uses comprehensive and innovative approaches to the diagnosis and treatment of prostatitis, aimed at removing the causes of the condition and easing symptoms.

Diagnosis of prostatitis:

  1. History and physical examination
    Includes a detailed account of the patient's symptoms and a rectal examination of the prostate gland.
  2. Urine tests
    Help identify the presence of infection.
  3. Prostatic fluid
    Analysis for inflammatory cells and bacteria.
  4. Ultrasound scan
    Used to assess the size and structure of the prostate gland and to identify any stones or cysts.
  5. PSA test (prostate-specific antigen)
    Helps rule out prostate cancer.

Treatments for prostatitis in Israel:

  1. Antibiotic treatment
    Used in bacterial prostatitis; the choice of medicine is based on sensitivity testing.
  2. Anti-inflammatory medicines
    Prescribed to reduce pain and inflammation.
  3. Alpha blockers
    Used to improve the flow of urine where there are symptoms of difficulty passing urine.
  4. Physiotherapy
    Includes magnetic therapy, laser therapy, heat treatment and prostate massage, aimed at improving circulation in the pelvic area and relieving spasm.
  5. Minimally invasive procedures
    Used to relieve congestion in the prostate gland.
  6. Lifestyle changes
    Advice on diet, increasing physical activity and managing stress.

Advantages of treatment in Israel:

  • An individual approach to every patient
    A treatment plan drawn up with the particular course of the illness in mind.
  • Highly qualified specialists
    Israel's leading urologists have extensive experience in treating prostatitis and other conditions of the prostate gland.
  • Innovative treatments
    The use of advanced technology and techniques to achieve the best results.
  • A comprehensive approach
    A combination of medicines, physiotherapy and lifestyle advice to address both the causes and the symptoms of the condition.

Treatment of prostatitis in Israel aims to relieve symptoms quickly, remove the causes of the inflammation and prevent recurrence, allowing patients to return to normal life. Modern techniques and an individual approach to treatment make the therapy highly effective and minimise the risk of possible complications, which makes Israel one of the leading destinations for urological care at international level.

fields.title: Umbilical hernia
fields.bodyHtml:
Umbilical hernia: advanced treatment in Israel

An umbilical hernia is the protrusion of part of the internal organs through a weakened area around the navel. Israel uses both traditional and innovative methods to treat umbilical hernias, delivering high effectiveness and a minimal risk of complications.

Diagnosis of an umbilical hernia:

  1. Clinical examination
    The main diagnostic method, involving inspection and palpation of the area around the navel, particularly when the abdominal muscles are tensed.
  2. Ultrasound scan
    Allows assessment of the size of the hernia opening and the contents of the hernia sac.
  3. Computed tomography (CT)
    Used for detailed imaging of the abdominal cavity and to establish the contents of the hernia in complex or unusual cases.

Treatments for an umbilical hernia:

  1. Conservative treatment:
    • Used rarely, and mainly as a temporary measure or in preparation for surgery. It involves wearing a truss or support belt to reduce pressure on the hernia.
  2. Surgery:
    • Open hernia repair: Used rarely (the second option is usually chosen); it involves an incision over the hernia, returning the contents of the hernia to the abdominal cavity and closing the hernia opening with sutures.
    • Laparoscopic surgery (hernioplasty): A minimally invasive procedure through small incisions, using a camera and special instruments to reduce the hernia and place a mesh implant that strengthens the abdominal wall.

Advantages of treatment in Israel:

  • An individual approach: The choice of treatment is based on the patient's individual circumstances, the size of the hernia and any accompanying conditions.
  • Highly qualified specialists: Operations are carried out by experienced surgeons specialising in minimally invasive techniques.
  • Modern equipment: The use of advanced technology and materials, such as biocompatible meshes, which reduce the risk of the hernia recurring and aid rapid recovery.
  • A comprehensive approach to recovery: All-round support during rehabilitation, including advice on physical activity and diet to prevent hernias recurring.

Modern treatment considerably improves quality of life after the operation, with little pain, rapid recovery and a low risk of recurrence. Patients receive all-round support at every stage of treatment, from preparation for surgery through to rehabilitation afterwards, which is the key to a successful outcome.

fields.title: Umbilical and other abdominal hernias
fields.bodyHtml:
Introduction

Abdominal hernias — umbilical, inguinal and others — are conditions in which internal organs protrude through weak areas or openings in the abdominal wall. These hernias can cause pain and discomfort and may require medical intervention. In this article we look at the methods of diagnosing and treating abdominal hernias, and at the advantages of seeking help in Israel.

Methods of diagnosis

Diagnosis of abdominal hernias begins with a thorough medical examination and the use of modern methods to establish the nature and extent of the hernia:

  • Clinical examination: the doctor carries out a physical examination, identifying any protruding area and checking for pulsation.
  • Ultrasound scan of the abdomen: an ultrasound examination allows the area of the abdominal hernia to be imaged and its size and nature established.
  • Computed tomography (CT): a method that gives a more detailed picture of the hernia and the tissues around it.

Methods of treatment

Treatment of abdominal hernias depends on the type of hernia and how far it has developed:

  • Surgery: where an abdominal hernia is significant, an operation may be required to restore normal anatomy and strengthen the weak area.
  • The use of a hernia truss: a temporary solution to hold the hernia and reduce discomfort.

Advantages of treatment in Israel

Israel provides high-quality medical care using advanced methods and technology. The advantages of treating abdominal hernias in Israel include:

  • Expert specialists: medical institutions in Israel work with experienced surgeons and gastroenterologists specialising in the treatment of abdominal hernias.
  • Modern methods: doctors in Israel use advanced methods of diagnosis and surgical treatment, which helps achieve the best results.
  • An individual approach: treatment in Israel is adapted to the individual needs of the patient, ensuring the best solution.

Conclusion

Abdominal hernias are conditions that require competent diagnosis and proper treatment. Modern diagnostic methods, surgical approaches and experienced specialists allow patients to overcome the discomfort and restore their health. Seeking help in Israel gives access to quality medical care and advanced treatments, which helps restore comfort and improve quality of life.
